One vanishing point, on the sea's horizon just right of centre, where the boardwalk's boards, its low rope rail and the line of the dunes converge.

## Cast

### The person
- What: a faceless adult person from the shared universe, standing in the open glass door of their home.
- Material: smooth, seamless, clear-to-lightly-frosted glass head and hands with a soft warm inner light, warm white turning soft gold at the core; a real head with skull, jaw and neck, and no face at all: no eyes, nose, mouth or smile; never saturated green or mint.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the body height, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like or balloon-like.
- Height: the tallest figure; the top of the head is well below the top of the tall glass door.
- Outfit: a long, soft oatmeal knit cardigan coat over a white T-shirt, relaxed light-grey linen trousers and simple white slides.
- Expression: faceless; fond pride shown by the body: one shoulder leaning on the door's frame, head tilted toward the departing agent.
- Pose: standing on the threshold, leaning one shoulder on the door frame, both feet on the threshold.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: smooth glass mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) hand: holding a white ceramic mug at chest height. Far (right) hand: resting closed on the edge of the open glass door.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the right of frame toward the boardwalk; head turned toward the agent.

### The traveller agent
- What: a small robot agent setting off for the day's work.
- Material: smooth, seamless sea-blue glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round satin-brass ear disc and a tiny antenna with a blue bead.
- Height: the top of its head reaches the person's hip.

- Expression: eager and ready: on its visor, two soft glowing oval eyes lifted toward the path ahead, held level; no mouth; a springy step.
- Pose: walking down the boardwalk away from the door, mid-stride, one foot on a board and the other lifting.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: round mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) mitten: holding the bag's strap at its chest. Far (right) mitten: swinging closed at its side in the stride.
- Facing: body side-on to the camera, walking toward the right of frame; head turned back over its shoulder toward the camera and the door so both eyes read.

- What: Ouro, the person's pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.

- Glass door: a tall frameless glass pivot door in a slim dark-bronze frame, swung open inward toward the left.

- Boardwalk: a raised boardwalk of weathered pale timber boards with a low rope rail on slim posts, leading from the step to the right over the dunes toward the sea, edged with silvery dune grass.
- Mug: white ceramic, in the person's near hand.
- Bag: sand-coloured canvas, on the agent.

## Setting
A modern beach house on the coastal dunes at sunrise: soft sand dunes with silvery marram grass and sea lavender, the boardwalk winding away over them toward a calm, bright sea, a pale beach and a low headland on the far right, a clear sky of soft blue and pale peach. A light sea breeze from the right lifts the agent's scarf and the dune grass toward the left.

## Light
Low, clear sunrise from the right over the sea is the key light, with soft warm rim light on every figure's right edge, clean pale shadows and a soft contact shadow under the person's feet, the agent's feet and Ouro. The bright sky fills the scene with clean, luminous daylight. The person's warm inner light glows softly through the glass head and hands. The sea glitters softly under the sun.

## Palette
Clear soft blue and pale peach sky, bright sea blue, pale sand, silvery dune green, pale cedar and white render, oatmeal and light grey; emerald for Ouro; sea blue and coral for the agent. No amber, no dark wood, no stone cottage.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing gesture, no waving and no thumbs-up.
- No stretched, tall-and-thin or stick-figure person; no green, mint or coloured-balloon person; no face on the person.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.
- No glowing trails or lines of light; no letters or speech bubbles floating in the air.
- No phones, laptops, monitors or screens.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No rustic, cottage, hobbit-hole or storybook house: no round door, no stone doorway, no thatch, no lantern, no dressing gown, no slippers.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No giant Ouro: he is never taller than the agent's knee.
- No image fades or vignettes.

generation.prompt:
# Labs: forks and experiments

## Story
In a bright, airy modern test lab under tall skylights, a small agent in clear safety goggles launches its newest little white paper glider from the bench while its person, leaning on the bench with a mug, watches it fly, and Ouro watches from a folded towel at the bench's end.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: the bench's top, as if we stand a few steps in front of the bench. One vanishing point, just right of centre on the far wall of tall windows, where the bench's edges, the pale concrete floor's joints and the skylight beams converge.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as an 8:3 strip; the crop band is the whole height, so the bench, the agent, the glider in flight, the person and Ouro sit together in the middle half of the width. Safe area: the left quarter is a white pegboard wall with three earlier paper gliders pinned to it and a tall shelf of neat pale boxes; the right quarter is the open bright lab floor with tall potted plants and the window wall. The glider flies in the upper middle, clear of every figure. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame.

## Cast

### The test agent
- What: a small robot agent running its experiment.
- Material: smooth, seamless soft apricot glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round satin-brass ear disc and a tiny antenna with an apricot bead.
- Height: standing on the bench top, its head reaches the standing person's shoulder.
- Outfit: a short white lab coat with the sleeves rolled up, and clear safety goggles on a strap over its visor.
- Expression: excited and hopeful: on its visor, two soft glowing oval eyes lifted toward the flying glider, held level; no mouth; it rises onto its toes.
- Pose: standing on the bench top near its middle, one arm still raised forward from the throw, both feet flat on the bench and fully visible.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: round mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) mitten: raised forward and open, just let go of the glider. Far (right) mitten: resting closed at its side.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the right of frame toward the glider; head lifted toward the glider so both eyes read.

### The person
- What: a faceless adult person from the shared universe, watching the test.
- Material: smooth, seamless, clear-to-lightly-frosted glass head and hands you can partly see through, with a soft warm inner light, warm white turning soft gold at the core; a real head with skull, jaw and neck, and no face at all: no eyes, nose, brow, mouth or smile; never milky, opaque or saturated green or mint.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the body height, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like or balloon-like.
- Height: the tallest figure; the bench top is at the person's hip.
- Outfit: a soft light-blue chambray shirt with the sleeves rolled, dark grey trousers and clean white sneakers.
- Expression: faceless; delighted interest shown by the body: head lifted toward the glider, shoulders relaxed.
- Pose: standing on the floor at the bench's left end, one hip leaning on the bench, both sneakers flat on the floor.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: smooth glass mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) hand: holding a white ceramic mug at chest height. Far (right) hand: resting flat on the bench top.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the right of frame; head lifted toward the glider.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is about as tall as the agent's head, much smaller than the agent.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: curious and pleased: eyes open and soft, following the glider, a small smile.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting on a folded pale grey towel on the bench's right end, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the towel.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view, turned up toward the glider.

## Props
- Bench: one long, clean pale birch workbench with a white top and four slim steel legs, one at each corner, running across the middle of the frame.
- Glider: a small plain white folded-paper glider in level flight in the upper middle of the picture, clear of everyone, with no marks.
- Bench tools: a small cutting mat, a steel ruler with no markings, a few sheets of plain white paper and a tidy pot of pencils.
- Pegboard: a white pegboard on the left wall with three earlier plain white paper gliders of different shapes pinned to it.
- Mug: white ceramic, in the person's near hand.
- Towel: a folded pale grey towel under Ouro.

## Setting
A bright, airy modern test lab in a converted warehouse on a clear morning: white walls, a pale polished concrete floor, tall white steel trusses with long skylights letting in sunlight, a far wall of tall steel-framed windows looking onto green trees, tall potted plants in white planters, and a tall shelf of neat pale boxes at the left. The air is still.

## Light
Bright, clean morning sunlight through the skylights from above and to the right is the key light, with crisp soft-edged skylight shadows across the floor and the bench, and soft rim light on every figure. Soft white daylight fills the whole lab, so it reads clean and luminous. A soft contact shadow sits under the bench's legs, the person's sneakers, the agent's feet and Ouro, and the glider casts a small soft shadow on the floor below it. The person's warm inner light glows softly through the glass head and hands.

## Palette
Clean white, pale birch and pale concrete, soft sky blue and leaf green, chambray blue and dark grey; apricot and white for the agent; emerald for Ouro. No amber, no dark wood.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing gesture, no waving and no thumbs-up.
- No stretched, tall-and-thin or stick-figure person; no green, mint, milky or coloured-balloon person; no face on the person.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols: every paper, glider, box and the ruler are blank.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.

Night light: the sun is gone; no sunbeams, no daylight and no sunlit patches anywhere. Deep, clean blue-black night sky with a few stars through the skylights. The light table's frosted top glows softly warm white from within and is the key light, lighting the chips, the robot, Ouro and the person from below; the three slim pendant lamps are lit, casting soft warm pools; the shelves and the far room fall into deep, clean shadow with soft warm reflections. Dark overall: most of the room is in deep blue-black shadow; only the light table's glow, the pendant lamps' pools and the figures' own glow are bright; the white walls, ceiling, shelves and cabinet read dark cool blue-grey, never cream, and the skylight glass is deep night blue. The person's glass head and hands glow softly warm from within, clear and see-through, and the person stays faceless; the robot's two visor eyes glow softly. Only the light and time of day change. Every hand of every person and robot stays exactly as drawn: a smooth mitten with one clearly visible thumb, never separate fingers. The robot's visor shows only its two glowing eyes and nothing else. The snake stays exactly as drawn. Same premium animated-film render, clean, contemporary and luminous. No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols. No glowing trails, lines of light or chains of dots. No vignette or fade.

- Ship's wheel: a classic round wooden ship's wheel with a brass hub, eight spokes and eight handle pegs, on a short brass pedestal mid-left. A glass-and-brass airship gondola with one flat, open oak deck on a single level, enclosed on every side by a brass rail with brass posts and teal-glass lattice panels, sailing above a sea of soft white clouds with far, soft snowy peaks. ## Palette
Soft morning blue sky with a hint of pale peach on the clouds, cloud white, brass gold and warm oak; warm white and soft amber for the person's glass, brown leather and moss green for his clothes; emerald for Ouro; jade, amber and sea-blue for the three agents; one red cap.

generation.prompt: Relight this picture as the same scene at true deep midnight. The wide picture band in the middle is the picture; the flat grey bars above and below it are empty canvas: paint them as more of the night sky and the airship's glass envelope above, and more of the oak deck below, continuing the picture seamlessly. Preserve every figure, pose, object and contour exactly as it is and in the same place; add nothing, remove nothing, redraw nothing; only the light changes. No daylight anywhere: no sun, no horizon glow, no warm light from the sky. A clean midnight-blue sky, darkest at the top, with distinct, restrained small stars, and one small clean full moon high in the sky on the right with a restrained soft glow; its cool silver-blue light comes from the right. The sea of clouds below is neutral silver-blue in shadow with only its right-facing tops softly silvered. The oak deck is dark, cool and matte. The brass lantern standing on the rail in the middle-left is lit with a small warm amber glow and a small warm pool of light on the deck below it; the tall post at the far left has no lamp and stays dark brass. The figures are lit only softly by the moon and that lantern: no rim light, no edge glow, no halo and no bright outline around any figure, head, scarf or snake; the man's frosted glass head is dim and soft, not glowing. Only the robots' two visor eyes glow softly. Every hand stays exactly as drawn. Same premium animated-film render. No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols. No glowing trails, lines of light or chains of dots. No vignette or fade.

- Pose: standing on both feet on the oak step stool at the right long side of the table, leaning in over the chart.

- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view toward the camera, turned a little toward the person, so the camera sees both eyes and his smile.

## Props
- Chart table: a long, heavy oak table with turned legs, its long sides parallel to our line of sight.

- Round window: a large round brass-framed window at the far end of the room, its glass in one clear pane with a single brass cross bar.

## Setting
A snug oak-panelled chart room inside the airship's gondola, moored before the voyage: curved ceiling beams, warm oak floorboards, a brass instrument shelf on the right wall holding a sextant and a rolled chart. Through the round window, dawn sky over a sea of clouds. Indoors, no wind: everything soft hangs still.

## Light
The hanging lamp is the key light, pooling warm gold on the chart and on both figures' heads and shoulders; cool peach dawn light from the round window rims them from behind. A soft contact shadow under every foot, under the stool's legs and under Ouro.

## Palette
Warm oak and brass gold, cream paper, soft dawn peach and blue in the window; moss green for the person's scarf, pale jade for Loop, emerald for Ouro; one brown leather satchel.

- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No fingers, no pointing and no thumbs-up: mittens only.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere, including on the chart.
- No glowing trails or lines of light.
- No electronics of any age: brass instruments and paper only.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No image fades or vignettes.
- No second agent, no second person and no second snake.

## Output
Three candidates, each generated whole at 1536x1024, quality high. The chosen one ships as a 1536x576 crop of rows 224 to 800 and a 4:3 phone crop centred on the table. The night twin is a time-of-day edit of the chosen candidate.

1. `brand/ouro.png`, for Ouro's exact face and coil only; not its pose or size.
